_comment: Least-privilege policy for the Kakis EC2 instance to send SMS sign-in codes.
Attach to an IAM role, then attach that role to instance i-0942e81ef83d2beec.
Publish is scoped with a condition so this role can only send SMS to phone
numbers — it cannot publish to your SNS topics. The sandbox actions let the
preflight check report sandbox status and manage verified test numbers; drop
them once you are out of the sandbox for good.
